phases.name: Protect the current site and establish the baseline
phases.gate: Protected field hashes and existing route/publication identities are recorded; no app or data reset.
tickets: Record exact old/current source revisions and deployment identities
Source snapshots and live observations are labelled separately; current work and cancelled audit are not mixed.
Inventory existing products, content, drafts, translations, settings and media usages read-only
Private scoped IDs/revisions/hashes cover protected fields without exporting customer values into this report.
Establish isolated QA and a codex/ feature branch
QA writes cannot reach the shared live database; no old bootstrap, seed or scraper executes.
Record current visual, keyboard and performance baselines
Representative desktop/phone screenshots and cold/warm timings name the candidate and environment.
Confirm source, asset and content ownership boundaries
Current contacts and all existing information frozen; unknown rights/offerings stay unresolved rather than inferred.

phases.name: Map every old page, section and supporting state
phases.gate: All 85 old page templates and 74 registry definitions have explicit target, dependency and disposition.
tickets: Complete public and utility route parity ledger
All 25 templates map to preserved canonical routes, new supported templates or explicit conditional states; dynamic records are not copied.
Complete Studio parent and child view ledger
All 60 page files, including create/edit/detail/print/auth, have a real destination or documented exclusion.
Specify all 74 registered sections and 16 landing-page blocks
Stable keys, order, conditions, existing data ownership and empty states recorded; Home has all 18 templates.
Inventory shared overlays and failure states
Header/menu, footer, cookie preferences, search, language, dialogs, loading, empty, forbidden and error states mapped from actual components.
Create before/target screenshot acceptance sheets
Compare same viewport and content; annotate content variance and accessibility/performance adaptations instead of silently changing design.

phases.name: Restore the old design system and shared frames
phases.gate: Public and Studio frames reflect the old visual language and remain usable with keyboard, touch and reduced motion.
tickets: Port palette, type roles, spacing and surface tokens
Old source tokens drive the system; font licensing/loading and semantic contrast checked.
Build public header, menu, footer and section navigation
Current links/contact values preserved; mobile focus, Escape and scroll behavior verified.
Build all five Studio groups and collapsed/mobile sidebar
All 32 destinations accounted for; only authorized, supported destinations become active links.
Unify forms, tables, cards, dialogs and status components
Contain thumbnails, support long text, keep sticky actions clear of focus and show errors beside the relevant field.
Port restrained motion with static fallbacks
Narrative motion matches reference where useful; frequent Studio actions stay brief; no LCP element hidden awaiting animation.

phases.name: Connect content and prove one complete editing workflow
phases.gate: A new homepage presentation draft saves, previews in the real renderer, publishes in isolated QA and restores into a draft without changing protected content.
tickets: Add compatible section, media-usage and layout manifests
Read adapters preserve existing payloads and IDs; new schema fields are optional/versioned and migrations idempotent.
Create shared saved-preview and dependency resolution
Preview binds to exact draft revision, locale, selected asset and layout; it cannot show unrelated live editor state.
Implement homepage hero/manifesto/featured-layout vertical slice
Use existing exact content/product selections; new sample copy belongs only to isolated QA fixtures.
Verify save, publish, comparison and restore-as-draft
Public projection matches intended revision; recovery does not publish, alter product records or reset settings.
Exercise permissions, concurrency and partial failure
401/403/409, missing asset, failed save/publish and unsaved navigation preserve data; lightweight list summaries remain bounded.

phases.name: Complete the homepage and long-form story templates
phases.gate: All 18 home templates plus About, Process, Materials, Custom Order, Contact, Large Format and Workshop structures are implemented with honest conditional visibility.
tickets: Complete all 18 homepage sections in source order
Furniture and Rooms stay distinct; separate Testimonials, Workshops and Printing templates have explicit evidence conditions.
Port About, maker, craft and studio-story compositions
Current copy and stored image usage preserved; generated people are never represented as actual staff.
Port Process sections, ten steps and four material entries
Reuse current stage wording and chronology; unknown process claims remain unpublished.
Port commission, contact and large-format story structures
Current form contracts and factual channels remain authoritative; filter discovery remains easy on phones.
Complete conditional workshop/printing and shared section editing
All templates have Studio ownership and preview; no invented dates, services, pricing or availability becomes public.

phases.name: Complete the remaining public pages and customer journey
phases.gate: Every public/utility ledger row renders its reference structure or documented conditional state, with no product/content change.
tickets: Port shop/category/three-journey and grouped search layouts
Current catalogue filters and identities retained; published Journal/Portfolio groups added without private/draft leaks.
Port product, saved-pieces, commission variants and receipt presentation
Protected product/form/gallery and immutable saved-brief contracts unchanged; WhatsApp still requires customer Send.
Port Journal, Portfolio, FAQ and testimonial presentations
Detail/index/empty/pagination states work with existing and new records; genuine proof separated from concept imagery.
Port all 16 validated custom landing-page block types
Hero, text, product/collection/editorial/quote readers, video and galleries adapt to current services; media/product selections remain frozen.
Finish policies, Imprint, aliases and system states
Approved text/SEO/routes preserved; errors, maintenance, rate limiting and private design preview do not leak drafts or gain unwanted indexing.

phases.name: Complete every Studio workspace and supporting view
phases.gate: All 32 requested destinations and 60 old page-file dispositions are reconciled with current server permissions and real services.
tickets: Complete Today group: overview, commissions, analytics and activity
Linked scoped counts, correct periods and source labels; no fake revenue, conversions or order activity.
Complete Catalogue group and its explicit exclusions
Products/categories/media/forms/import/export views preserve records; scraper and ingestion-dependent Catalog Fill remain on hold, not mock successes.
Complete Content group: copy, images, sections, process, materials, navigation and forms
Exact-record links and actual preview; existing values are viewable and preserved during migration, with additive new-record editing.
Complete Editorial group with list/new/edit/detail/revision views
Journal, Portfolio, Testimonials, FAQs, Pages and Landing Pages support genuine record lifecycle and source requirements.
Complete Settings, access and conditional subscribers/research tooling
Current auth/staff policy retained; no new public signup or bulk outreach; non-supported services have explicit prerequisites.

phases.name: Complete orders and editorial display ordering
phases.gate: Current eight-stage order workflow remains intact; editorial reordering is an independent, versioned presentation change.
tickets: Finish commission board/list/detail and scoped filters
Saved brief, assignee, stage, notes, references and follow-ups render from current records with server authorization.
Add or adapt protected order print/card view
Print only authorized saved facts; no unknown care/material/timing guarantees and no private data in screenshots.
Verify submission, receipt and manual messaging end-to-end in QA
Duplicate-submit/error handling and customer consent preserved; synthetic records never count as genuine inquiry evidence.
Implement editorial order manifests and accessible reorder controls
Drag plus Move up/down, stable IDs, curated/default sort distinction, concurrency guard and correct full-list behavior.
Connect order preview, publication and revision restore
First default equals current order; later editorial layout revisions are explicit; product/gallery order and selections unchanged.

phases.name: Build editorial filters and the 480-entry production register
phases.gate: 120 planned entries per editorial section are tracked independently and filter coverage reflects real metadata.
tickets: Reconcile 120 Journal and 120 FAQ proposals against existing records
Duplicates replaced with distinct useful proposals; existing content is never rewritten or counted as new.
Prepare 120 Portfolio and 120 Testimonial evidence slots
No invented project titles, quotes, ratings or people; required sources, rights, attribution and consent tracked privately.
Implement appropriate public and Studio filter facets
URL/applied chips/clear/pagination and visible counts; existing categories unchanged; empty combinations remain honest.
Add publication evidence and language-review workflow
Author/meaning/native review states distinct; publication does not imply native review; fallback and SEO locales correct.
Bound queries and enforce import/create collision checks
Summaries for lists, record detail on demand, stable pagination, dry-run review and new-ID-only writes.

phases.name: Produce, review and stage all new content and media
phases.gate: 480 is complete only when each section has 120 unique approved new entries; evidence shortages remain open and are not filled with fiction.
tickets: Create Journal and FAQ content in small reviewed batches
Ten-entry batches with factual sources, useful depth, duplicate check, exact draft preview and current policy links.
Build genuine Portfolio stories and Testimonial records
One real project/feedback source per record; original quote preserved and translations linked to it, not counted twice.
Review Drive assets for new usages and responsive crops
Verify identity/rights/disclosure, optimized size, alt/caption, focal point and desktop/mobile composition; existing assignments untouched.
Complete language, factual and publication review records
Native-review evidence supplied by a real reviewer; unresolved entries remain draft with reason.
Stage approved new records and reconcile counts
Review new IDs and publication revisions before any authorized production batch; no existing record mutation or false completion count.

phases.name: Complete regression, visual and acceptance checks
phases.gate: Current candidate has reproducible engineering evidence; human, field and genuine-customer evidence is separately recorded without false passes.
tickets: Compare all templates and sections at required viewports
Reference/current screenshots, long locales, empty/full lists, error/loading states and cropped subjects covered.
Run protected-data and real publication/permission regressions
Before/after field comparison, role scope, stale saves, exact draft preview and revision recovery pass in isolated QA.
Measure loading, interaction and layout stability
Record hosted/local cold/warm samples and media/bundle budgets; field p75 remains separate from lab measurements.
Run automated and actual human accessibility checks
Keyboard, contrast, zoom, reduced motion, screen-reader task log and physical-phone task log name actual evidence; unavailable equipment stays open.
Reconcile factual, native-language, consent and remaining gaps
No pending item silently marked done; real inquiry and real-user evidence require actual consent-safe observations.

phases.name: Release through a detailed PR and verify production
phases.gate: Explicit release instruction, checked PR, exact main commit and READY deployment verified; content and external acceptance status remain separate.
tickets: Prepare final change report, reviewable commits and release gate
List all module/template changes, protected baseline, migrations, licenses, test evidence, exclusions and remaining content dependencies.
Open detailed PR only under the applicable release instruction
No secrets/raw customer evidence; application changes and content publication steps distinguished; approved scope explicit.
Merge approved candidate and verify Vercel deployment
Required repository checks pass; exact main SHA matches READY deployment; no automatic reset/seed/import.
Verify public pages, signed-in Studio and approved content batches
Current contacts/SEO/indexing/Imprint, routes, records and media verified using small read-only production checks.
Record observation and reversible rollback decisions
Prior compatible code and draft revisions available; missing genuine inquiry/field/human evidence remains open until observed.
